description:
A powerful native Android app to control your Linode instances, domains, support tickets and more...
Features
- Multiple accounts
- Create a domain
- Import a domain
- Add a domain record
- Edit a record
- Add a payment method
- Create a support ticket
- Reply to a support ticket
- Stop a server
- Change a server's root password
- Enable server rescue mode
- Delete a server
- Enable server backups and create snapshots
- Dashboard (quick overview)
- Create an instance
- Update account token
- View all instances
- View events
- View profile
- Reboot a server
- Delete a domain record
- View support tickets (open and closed) and their replies
- View domains
- View domain records
- View payment methods
- View payments
- View invoices
- View volumes
- View Linode plans
- View regions
- View NodeBalancers
Complete list of features: https://codeberg.org/swatian/NexNode/wiki/Features
Source code: https://codeberg.org/swatian/NexNode
Developer: https://mastodon.social/@mmarif
